name: Rivest–Shamir–Adleman public-key cryptosystem
description: A published public-key method for encryption and digital signatures.

date.basis: Institutional repository catalog identifies the memorandum issue month.

events.statement: An MIT technical memorandum describing the RSA public-key method is dated April 1977 in MIT’s repository.

evidence.supports: MIT DSpace catalog identifies memo MIT-LCS-TM-082 by Rivest, Shamir and Adleman, issued April 1977; its abstract describes the public-key encryption and signature method. The underlying scanned file was inaccessible during inspection.

events.caveats: The institutional catalog and abstract were inspected; the underlying scan returned a rate-limit response. The catalog date is not evidence of an exact day of public dissemination.
